Hi Sandra / Tim —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: Avenity is looking to evaluate Redwood Inference for inference cost reduction on your clinical-document workflows and to understand how private deployment would map to your VPC footprint. Key asks from your side: short product intro (30m), a follow-up technical deep dive with infra/security, and a draft mutual action plan to align procurement and PoC milestones.

To keep momentum, can you confirm which of the two compact windows below works best for the 30-minute intro (we'll keep it concise — product + one quick Q&A):

- Option A: Tue Sep 7, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Sep 8, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither works, propose one alternative and I’ll try to accommodate. Also: please confirm attendees (we recommend a product stakeholder + one infra/security person so we can surface the right technical owner).

I attached a one-slide briefing and a draft mutual action plan with suggested milestones and owners — feel free to mark up.

Attachments: [deck-30min-briefing.pdf (PDF, 1 slide)], [mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)]

Thanks,
Monica Patel
